description: Reviewed Dolt port: UPDATE on table with composite BINARY primary key and foreign key

source.case: DoltForeignKeyTests: UPDATE on table with composite BINARY primary key and foreign key

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE parent (id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE child (id1 bytea NOT NULL, id2 bytea NOT NULL, parent_id int, val int, PRIMARY KEY (id1, id2), CONSTRAINT fk_parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES parent (id))
UPDATE child SET val = 20 WHERE id1 = '\x0000000000000001' AND id2 = '\x0000000000000002'
SELECT val FROM child WHERE id1 = '\x0000000000000001' AND id2 = '\x0000000000000002'
